Hi Laura — thanks for the clear list. Attaching our redacted 2025 Type II report and current subprocessors sheet. Quick answers inline: 

1) Coverage: Our 2025 SOC 2 Type II covers the shared managed platform (multi-tenant) in us-west-2. That report is NOT a carve-out for the managed platform.
2) Subservice activities: physical host security, hypervisor patching, and network segmentation are included. Provider-managed KMS keys are covered for encryption-at-rest for customer data when using CloudHaven-managed keys; we note that customer-managed keys (BYOK) are out of scope for our SOC and require separate attestation.
3) Dedicated instances: Dedicated (single-tenant) instances are scoped under a separate control set and are covered under our separate dedicated-instance SOC addendum. We can provide the addendum if you need it.
4) Bridge letter: We can provide a bridge letter for the 2025 audit period. The bridge will reference the report and list any interim changes.

Attachments: CloudHaven_SOC2_2025_TypeII_redacted.pdf (PDF, 3.2MB); CloudHaven_Subprocessors_2026-01.xlsx (XLSX, 120KB)

Let us know if you need explicit language on responsibility for backups and deletion flows — by default backups of infrastructure images are provider-managed, but application-level backups are customer-managed.
